name: driver-docs
description: Aplikacja kierowcy – system zarządzania dokumentami przewozowymi (CMR, WZ).

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w backend -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:infra:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait postgres-test minio-test && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm minio-test-init
